tool_input.new_string:
config:
      domain: 'Security'
    columns:
      - name: security_key
        description: "Surrogate key"
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: ticker
        description: "Resolved ticker symbol"
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: cusip
        description: "Resolved CUSIP"
      - name: isin
        description: "International Securities Identification Number"
      - name: security_name
        description: "Security display name"
      - name: asset_class
        description: "Asset class (US Equity, Fixed Income, etc.)"
      - name: sub_asset_class
        description: "Sub-classification (Large Cap Growth, Broad Market, etc.)"
      - name: sector
        description: "Market sector"
      - name: security_type
        description: "Instrument type (Equity, ETF, Cash)"
      - name: exchange
        description: "Primary exchange"
      - name: currency
        description: "Trading currency"
      - name: issuer
        description: "Security issuer / fund manager"
      - name: country
        description: "Country of domicile"
      - name: inception_date
        description: "Security listing or fund inception date"
      - name: expense_ratio
        description: "Annual expense ratio (ETFs/funds)"
      - name: dividend_yield
        description: "Current dividend yield"
      - name: market_cap_category
        description: "Market cap bucket (Large Cap, Multi Cap, N/A)"
      - name: is_esg
        description: "ESG-screened flag"
      - name: risk_rating
        description: "Risk rating (1=Low to 5=High)"
      - name: benchmark_index
        description: "Primary benchmark index"
      - name: is_active
        description: "Whether the security is actively traded"
